identified_as: South High School (West Mifflin South), West Mifflin, Allegheny Co.
era: Merged into West Mifflin Area HS (blue and gold, Titans).
notes: Colours and nickname from the school's own 1967 'Sohian' yearbook; same colours as the later merged West Mifflin Area HS but taken from South's own years.
evidence: e-yearbook OCR of South HS (West Mifflin) 'Sohian' 1967: cheerleaders ran 'Blue and Gold Week'; homecoming goal posts decorated 'using blue and gold streamers' at 'Spartan Stadium'; teams called 'the Spartans' throughout. Page images are not downloadable (410), so no hex.

notes: Red and black appear in Lititz HS's own years (1927 band sash; 1950 yearbook sports text). A 1940 class pennant is navy and gold, likely class colours, not school colours.

identified_as: North Mont (North-Mont) High School, Turbotville, Northumberland Co. (District 4)
era: Closed; Turbotville area later served by Warrior Run HS (Warrior Run SD).
notes: Identity found via e-yearbook (North Mont HS 'Survey' 1955, Turbotville, PA; school had a wrestling team, teams listed as 'Turbotville'). Colours are only inferred from the school paper/club named 'Blue and White'; no explicit school-colours statement found. Successor named from geography, not checked.
evidence: e-yearbook OCR of North Mont HS 'Survey' 1955 (only year online): alma mater 'good-bye dear old North-Mont'; seniors list 'Wrestling 3, 4'; a club/staff page headed 'BLUE AND WHITE' and seniors list 'Blue & White 3, 4' (likely the school paper, named after colours). Class colours (green and white) are class-only. Page images not downloadable, so no hex.

identified_as: Ambler High School / Ambler Joint High School, Ambler, Montgomery Co.
era: Predecessor of Wissahickon HS (blue and gold, Trojans).
notes: From Ambler's own 'Pinnacle' yearbooks (1940-1957); Wissahickon later kept the same Trojans / blue and gold.
evidence: e-yearbook OCR of Ambler HS 'Pinnacle': teams called 'the Trojans' in 1940, 1950 and 1957 (paper 'Trojan Times'); 1950 football page (garbled OCR) 'Our young Blue and [G]old footballer[s] tallied 65 points'. Only one colour mention, page scans not downloadable, so no hex.

identified_as: Sandy Township High School, DuBois (Sandy Twp.), Clearfield Co.
era: Merged into DuBois Area SD (red, black and white).
notes: From Sandy Township HS's own 1958 yearbook; the class colours listed in other years (blue and gold, light blue and white, red and gold) are class colours, not the school's.
evidence: e-yearbook OCR of Sandy Township HS 'Flambeau' 1958, page 81 (alma mater 'Dear Old Sandy High' and cheer): 'Fight, fight, fight for the red and black / Victory will our slogan be / Dear Sandy Hi School'. Page images not downloadable, so no hex. Mascot not found.

identified_as: West Side Central Catholic High School, 316 N. Maple Ave., Kingston, Luzerne Co. (opened 1954; renamed Bishop O'Reilly HS in 1973)
era: Renamed Bishop O'Reilly HS (1973); closed 2007, merged into Holy Redeemer HS (red, white and gold, Royals).
notes: Identity is the only Catholic central high school in Kingston (the bracket name is read as West Side Central Catholic). Colours and Queensmen nickname are documented for the same school under its later O'Reilly name; not confirmed for the 1950s-60s years specifically.
evidence: bishoporeilly.org (alumni site 'Bishop O'Reilly/Central Catholic Alumni'): history says West Side Central Catholic HS opened 8 Sept 1954 and was renamed Bishop O'Reilly in 1973; the crest description has 'a wreath of the colors, gold and blue'; alma mater 'Raise a cheer, O Queensmen ... Let her colors fly. Gold of Christ's great Kingship / Blazoned on Queen Mary's blue'. The site's WSCC crest image is greyscale (logocolors: only black/greys), so no hex.
